text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While in the cafeteria, I overhear Meisho
Doto
discussing something with
Manhattan Cafe and
Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, sooo... about this photo...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm just going to take a look.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that build'n kinda looks like my
fam'ly home.
Makes me feel all fuzzy
inside...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I heard this wonderful old
Japanese-style house
was built many
decades ago, so I took a photo of
it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's blurry... but I can make out a girl in a
kimono
with a bob cut.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E-e-exactly! But I'm certain there was nobody there when I took the photo!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This girl... She's looking right at us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I knooow!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-do you think I've been cursed for
taking this
photo?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But looks like she's smil'n to me, so I
reck'n you'll
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B'sides, she doesn't look like the
vengeful type or
anything. Don't worry
'bout it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: R-really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All sortsa odd stuff happened at my old
home,
but I was always taught that
noth'n bad'll happen
if I behave!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I heard the sound of
footsteps comin'
from an empty room or
saw flashes of blue light,
but I wouldn't
let any of it spook me one bit! I still

don't!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you behave yourself, you say... Hehe...
That's
just like you, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beings from the other side are drawn to

kindhearted souls... So I'm sure that...
Oh, see,
there's another one... beside
Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaagh! Am... Am I beyond saving?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My eyes meet with Meisho Doto's as she
trembles
in fear.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohh... I'm sorry for causing such a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-they really are!
choice_data_list: 2人が幽霊平気なのはすごい……

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C'mon now, you're gonna be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Long as you don't go provoking 'em,
they won't
do anyth'n to you. They're
just like bumblebees!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And perhaps... the ghosts
are just as
afraid of us, the living...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! At this point the only thing I'm
not afraid
of is is a tanuki!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino isn't afraid... That makes her easy
to talk
to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, hearing that sure puts a grin
on my
face! Let's chew all the fat you
fancy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Have you had any other... supernatural

experiences?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This one time, when I was play'n up in
the
mountains, I heard a child laugh'n
beside me even
though nobody else was
about.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And this other time, when it was snow'n
pretty
heavy, I saw a lady with a
traditional braided hat,
stand'n real still.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! This stuff is way too scary for
small talk!
